prompt: The same premium silver 40-foot high-cube ISO shipping container, brushed metal corrugated walls, consistent corner castings and believable steel hardware. Three-quarter oblique at approximately mid-height, showing the closed double-door end and one full long side, with only a small roof edge visible; no overhead/roof-only or underside plate. Maintain nominal external proportions of 12.192 m length, 2.438 m width and 2.896 m height. Corrugated walls, roof, doors and structural frame have cool brushed silver with a restrained satin sheen and fine consistent grain. Corner castings, hinges, locking rods and handles are neutral silver/titanium metal; door seals are natural dark matte rubber. Isolated on transparency with comfortable margin, crisp realistic edges and restrained blue-tinted specular light in #7BCBFF and #B9E7FF. Maintain identical dimensions and structural details across later model views. No text, serial number, logo, baked shadow, yellow/gold glow, dents that change between views or scene background. No additional painted blue or carbon panel is requested. All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.
